messages.text:
Can we link this row to each progress ? 
It hard to see this row came from which progress.
I'd like to get some link for click between status and progress. it'll easier to tracking and understand between them.

Good idea, logged as I-104. The toolsmith who is fixing the comment button (ts-i103) will do this right after it: each Status row gets a link to its Progress item, and each Progress item a link back to its Status row. Where there's no match there will be no link, rather than a broken one. I'll tell you here when it's live.

Good point. Linking a status row to its progress entries is a change to the console itself, so it goes through the lead (tooling changes need a toolsmith and tests). I'm escalating it now. For now, this row is the countdown roll fix (your task T-030, item 10): each hero clock digit rolls as one GPU animation, built on the countdown strips fix (cd-strip), which has landed. Its progress entries are the cd-roll-ca and cd-strip items.
Done (live now): each Status row now links to its item on the Progress page, and each Progress item links back to its Status row. Reload the console page to see the links.

history.note: User asks for status rows to link to their progress entries (console feature, tooling). Not a cd-roll-ca decision; I answered what this row covers.
